items.title: Extract recomputeInitCheckHash / blockingInitCheckIssues / missingRequiredInitCheckAgents into a core module
items.context: core/machine.ts:8 imports blockingInitCheckIssues / missingRequiredInitCheckAgents / recomputeInitCheckHash from ../handlers/init-check.js — a core->handlers upward layer violation, same type as the delivery-check hash issue fixed in B-37e9 F-001. These three init-check primitives only need StoryStore + crypto (pure core dependencies). Move them into core/init-check-hash.ts (or core/init-check-gate.ts); have handlers/init-check.ts and core/machine.ts both consume the core module, single implementation. Do not change INIT_CHECK phase semantics, do not change the reviewer flow. Analysis-and-relocation backlog — does not block main.
items.userSees: Expected verification transcript includes exact lines: npm run build -> exit 0; npm run test:init-check-bootstrap -> exit 0; npm run test:worktree-authority-smoke -> exit 0; rg "from \x27..\/handlers\/init-check|from \"..\/handlers\/init-check" packages/main/src/core -> no matches.

happy.desc: Extract init-check hash/gate primitives into core and rewire handler plus machine to consume that module; npm run build passes.

edge.desc: Existing init_check_set records from both required reviewers still satisfy INIT_CHECK, including agentId fallback and reviewer prefix matching.

adversarial.desc: Missing required reviewer, high/critical issue, or stale hash still blocks INIT_CHECK; no core source imports handlers/init-check after refactor.
